title: Argos catalog entry
description: One entry per canonical tool. The map key is the canonical id (lowercase, [a-z0-9-]). Identity is the `upstream` URL, not the id -- distro names diverge, upstream repos do not.

upstream.description: Canonical source URL. THE dedupe key. Prefer the VCS repo over a homepage. Normalised by argos.identity before comparison.

tier.description: 1 = in nixpkgs. 2 = mechanically packageable (go/rust/python/script). 3 = manual work. 4 = will not package (unfree, blob, abandoned).

nixpkgs.description: Attribute path in nixpkgs, e.g. 'nmap' or 'python3Packages.oletools'. Required when tier = 1.

local.description: Attribute name under pkgs/by-name/ when packaged in this repo.

platforms.description: Nix platform strings. Defaults to linux-only if omitted.

capabilities.description: Runtime privileges the tool needs. Drives modules/nixos wrappers and README warnings. A devShell cannot grant these.

alternatives.description: Canonical ids of tools that supersede or substitute this one.

aliases.description: Other names this tool ships under. Used by the importers to short-circuit lookups.

provenance.description: Which upstream distro ships this, under what package name. Populated by importers; drives the coverage dashboard. Do not hand-edit.
